title: Arrived broken, and I’m not surprised
text: Arrived broken, and I’m not surprised. This arrived with the spout broken off, despite the packaging seeming adequate. Upon inspection, I wasn’t surprised: the spout was just silver-painted plastic, and very flimsy. I liked the design, but will look for something similar that is metal, and more sturdy.

product_metadata.title: Umbra Vapor Frosted Glass Soap Pump White 7.975x4.675x4.345
features: SIMPLE AND ATTRACTIVE: Vapor is modern and sleek in design, with a construction of sturdy molded glass, an etched interior, and high-gloss exterior

STURDY MATERIAL: Vapor is durable and solid through its heavy glass composition, providing weight to ground and secure the pump in place. This extra weight prevents the glass from slipping on the countertop.
FITS HIGH VOLUMES: With a capacity of 11 oz. or 325 mL, Vapor can hold large volumes of liquid, while occupying a small surface area
RUST-FREE: Vapor’s pump mechanism is carefully crafted to prevent rusting and ensures the product is long-lasting
5-YEAR MANUFACTURER : Shop with confidence knowing that all Umbra products are backed by a 5-Year Manufacturer
description: The Capello bath hardware collection by Umbra was inspired by the fixtures and details found in classical architecture. This graceful collection focuses on cohesive proportions with an antique sensibility, great for a coordinated bathroom look. The 24 inch towel bar comes in two finishes- brushed nickel or chrome and measures 26-1/2 Inch by 3-3/4 Inch by 2-3/4 Inch. Made of die cast zinc, Capello towel bars mount easily to the wall and include hardware and mounting instructions.Designed by Sung Wook Park for Umbra- original, modern, casual, functional and affordable design for the home.
